page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2gne.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at 2.5 GHz. This instance features 32 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core, providing 32 vCPUs. It is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core. A key hardware feature is the inclusion of 3839 GB of bundled local SSD storage, alongside a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps. The instance runs on the KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark data reveals a clear performance tradeoff between single-core and multi-core execution. Single-core CPU performance, measured via stress-ng and Geekbench, falls into the bottom 25% tier, and single-threaded gzip compression is in the bottom 10%. Conversely, multi-core performance across stress-ng, Geekbench, and PassMark is consistently average, placing in the middle 50% tier. Memory bandwidth tests for both small cached blocks and large uncached blocks also demonstrate average tier performance, as do database operations and Redis SET throughput.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.i2gne.8xlarge offers a balanced resource density for workloads requiring substantial local storage without the premium of high-end compute processors. The dedicated core allocation ensures consistent multi-threaded execution, though the lower single-core performance limits its efficiency for single-threaded tasks. This profile is suited for distributed databases, local caching layers, static web serving, and multi-threaded data processing pipelines that benefit from the 3839 GB local SSD.
